scope.pluginAdapter: In-memory loadData/saveData with structuredClone and Map-backed records
scope.sdkAdapter: Node registerHooks stubs the siyuan SDK; archived-member projection reads receive a controlled error, other probes issue no SDK requests
scope.moduleLoading: Node registerHooks resolves extensionless local TypeScript imports and transpiles with the repository TypeScript compiler; production functions are invoked unchanged
scope.limitations: These probes demonstrate deterministic production service/data/domain behavior. They do not verify real Plugin storage, cross-window Web Locks, actual SiYuan UI, native editor CAS, or devices.

probes.name: archived-editor-status-coercion
probes.level: production service and data with in-memory Plugin; UI payload derived from source
probes.interpretation: Editing another field in an archived organization's active member sends an implicit former transition and persists it. Projection errors do not roll back the member fact.

probes.name: template-stale-editor-after-merge
probes.level: production data layer with in-memory Plugin
sequence: Keep an editor draft containing tpl-base
Merge a new tpl-new through mergeTemplatesStore
Save the old editor draft after modifying tpl-base
probes.interpretation: The lock serializes saves but the stale whole-list replacement deletes an unseen concurrent addition.

probes.name: migration-hidden-tombstone-delete
probes.level: production migration service and data with in-memory Plugin; UI gating established from source
probes.interpretation: The preview omits interaction deletion, import still deletes the event, and the result loses the removed count. A tombstone-only bundle has no normal confirmation entry.

probes.name: migration-ignores-invalid-raw-snapshot
probes.level: production migration service and data with in-memory Plugin
probes.interpretation: Migration uses projected events/tombstones and ignores the invalid rawStore that independent interaction backup parsing would reject.

probes.name: template-dollar-replacement
probes.interpretation: A literal replacement string interprets the dollar-match sequence instead of preserving the person's name.

probes.name: lunar-birthday-age
probes.level: production pure domain function; no current UI consumer of age found
probes.interpretation: The documented completed-years field uses current lunar year minus birth year plus one even on the actual birthday.
